description: This file defines the ImportFile class, which extends ImportDataSource and handles processing CSV import files within the SuiteCRM application. It manages file reading, CSV property auto-detection, character set detection, header row handling, iteration over file rows, and file cleanup.

classes.name: ImportFile
classes.description: Class for processing import files (specifically CSV files), providing functionality for reading, parsing, encoding detection, and iteration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ImportFile object; opens the specified file, sets delimiters, enclosures, and detects encoding.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the file stream and deletes the file if configured to do so.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object for security reasons.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if the file pointer is valid, indicating the file exists and is readable.

methods.name: getNextRow
methods.description: Reads the next row from the CSV file, processes data such as encoding conversion and line ending normalization.

methods.name: getFieldCount
methods.description: Returns the number of fields in the current row.

methods.name: getNumberOfLinesInfile
methods.description: Counts total lines in the file.

methods.name: autoDetectCSVProperties
methods.description: Automatically detects CSV delimiter and enclosure settings.

methods.name: getFieldDelimeter
methods.description: Returns the CSV delimiter used.

methods.name: getFieldEnclosure
methods.description: Returns the CSV enclosure character used.

methods.name: autoDetectCharacterSet
methods.description: Detects the character set encoding of the CSV file.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the detected date format of the CSV.

methods.name: getTimeFormat
methods.description: Returns the detected time format of the CSV.

methods.name: setHeaderRow
methods.description: Sets whether the CSV has a header row.

methods.name: hasHeaderRow
methods.description: Determines if the CSV has a header row, optionally auto-detects header presence.

methods.name: setImportFileMap
methods.description: Injects properties from an import map into the object.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current row index (used for iteration).

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current row data (used for iteration).

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next row (used for iteration).

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position has a valid row (used for iteration).

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets file pointer and loads the first row (used for iteration).

methods.name: getTotalRecordCount
methods.description: Returns total number of data records, accounting for header row.

methods.name: loadDataSet
methods.description: Loads a subset of data into the internal dataset, optionally skipping header.

methods.name: getHeaderColumns
methods.description: Returns header column names if header row exists.
